semantic_bindings.accelerometer_bias_estimator_prior: OU mean predictor while active; held while disabled
semantic_bindings.magnetometer_acceptance: lastMagDiag().accepted becomes true only after the correction is actually applied
semantic_bindings.magnetic_attempt_counter: the wrapper control counter advances after a forwarded attempt and is not an informative-service certificate
semantic_bindings.live_handoff: the certified tail inherits the actual reached execution
semantic_bindings.accel_bias_release: release enables estimator bias dynamics and does not reset physical accelerometer bias
semantic_bindings.magnetic_information_covariance: lastMagDiag().S records the actual innovation covariance factored by an applied shipping magnetometer correction and is the covariance used by MAGNETIC SERVICE whitening
semantic_bindings.joint_bias_prediction: z=[e_b;b_true] uses [[phi_e I,(1-phi_e) I],[0,I]] with one shared physical-increment column [I;I]. Corrections and projection are separate operations.
semantic_bindings.projection_scope: Positive radius after a finite completed injection; nonpositive radius disables projection; projection changes the estimate but not covariance; invalid attitude injection may bypass projection.
semantic_bindings.integral_innovation: With a single fixed capture origin S_true=q(t)-q(T_c), shipping r_S=-S_hat=e_S-S_true retains the physical potential forcing.
semantic_bindings.magnetic_coordinate_transport: The complete preceding transport may be rectangular between error charts. Dimension compatibility and finite audits do not certify a release map or source-uniform information.
semantic_bindings.point_audit_scope: Supplied finite-error values and structural flags are diagnostic assertions, not a verified source-uniform certificate. Missing bounds, vacuous prefixes and overflow cannot promote completion.
semantic_bindings.held_accelerometer_bias_hold: While the hold is in force the estimate, its covariance block and its zeroed cross-covariances are unchanged, so the held bias is an invariant coordinate of the superword error map and no full-state rho<1 exists on that leg.
semantic_bindings.superword_feasibility_scope: The exported superword and its high-precision evaluation measure one reached execution. They are non-promoting evidence: no ratio, direction or margin they report discharges a proof obligation or establishes source uniformity.
